title: Round 30 (F336): Main game loop hierarchy (WinMain msg loop -> state machine -> 0x41BB00 tick) + entity click/pick dispatch 0x419D40 (4 painter arrays + per-type click paths) + IAT PeekMessage/GetLocalTime/PtInRect + 0x777200 arithmetic fix
objective: Decode the top-level game loop: WinMain message loop, [0x8B1878] state machine (intro/char-select/in-game), the per-frame tick 0x41BB00, the screen-effect sub-update 0x41B8D0, and the entity click/pick dispatcher 0x419D40 (window-id / entity-type dispatch at 0x41A0D9, previously mislabeled '0x41A0C0 window-id dispatch'). Also resolve the 0x777200 vs hero+0x52E5C notify-window VA discrepancy (Round 29 arithmetic slip).
question: What is the exact call hierarchy from WinMain down to the per-frame UI/entity update? How does the client dispatch clicks/picks by entity window-id (0x10/0x16/0x3F/0x14A-0x14E/0x48/9/0x35/0x150)? Where is the clock text drawn? Is 0x777200 the id-15 notice window?
method: Capstone linear disassembly of MIR3.EXE .text (VA = file_offset + 0x400000); E8 caller scan by raw-byte regex; IAT name resolution via pefile DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT; string decode via pefile get_memory_mapped_image GBK; cdecl arg order (last push = arg1). Cross-checked against F294 notice-banner-lifecycle-evidence.json and F331 message-rings/world-lifecycle evidence.
